```{r}
#| include: FALSE

library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(httr2)
library(httr)
library(tidycensus)
```

```{r}
#function to get data from the API
get_wows <- function() {
  #gets the 91 "wows" in order
  url <- "https://owen-wilson-wow-api.onrender.com/wows/ordered/0-90"
  #GET request to the API
  response <- GET(url)
  #convert API response into a list of R objects
  details <- content(response, "parsed")
  #return the retrieved data
  return(details)
}
```

```{r}
# function to turn the API list into a tibble
make_wow_data <- function(details) {

  # creating tibble that includes the variables of interest
  wow <- tibble(
    movie = character(), 
    year = double(), 
    character = character(), 
    release_date = character(),
    director = character(), 
    movie_duration = character(), 
    timestamp = character(),
    full_line = character(),
    current_wow_in_movie = double(),
    total_wows_in_movie = double(),
    video = character()
  )

  # use for loop to fill in the next row of the tibble for each wow
  for(i in 1:length(details)) {
    wow[i, 1] <- details[[i]]$movie
    wow[i, 2] <- as.numeric(details[[i]]$year)
    wow[i, 3] <- details[[i]]$character
    wow[i, 4] <- details[[i]]$release_date
    wow[i, 5] <- details[[i]]$director
    wow[i, 6] <- details[[i]]$movie_duration
    wow[i, 7] <- details[[i]]$timestamp
    wow[i, 8] <- details[[i]]$full_line
    wow[i, 9] <- as.numeric(details[[i]]$current_wow_in_movie)
    wow[i, 10] <- as.numeric(details[[i]]$total_wows_in_movie)
    wow[i, 11] <- details[[i]]$video[["720p"]]
  }

  return(wow)
}
```


## Variables in the CSV: 

- movie: Name of the movie
- year: Year the movie was released
- character: Character Owen Wilson plays in the movie
- release_date : Date the movie was released
- director: Movie Director
- movie_duration: Length of the movie
- timestamp: Time of the wow in the movie
- full_line: Dialogue spoken during the Wow
- current_wow_in_movie: Which number wow it is in the movie
- total_wows_in_movie: How many Wows Owen Wilson says in the movie
- video: Link to video clip of the wow

## Reflection

To make this final csv, we used GitHub branches and pull requests to edit on our own time. There were a lot of technical difficulties with Git, where we would do all the correct steps and Git wouldn't recognize that any changes were made and/or pull requests active. Working in the branches worked well for when we were on our own, but when we were working in person together, using GitHub added some unnecessary complications. In the future, we may use branches to edit on our own time, but make changes directly on the main project when we are together and can talk about changes we are making.
